name: Summer Baker
source:
"She is a hot, sexy, bitchy and spoiled brat. She knows it all too well and uses it to her advantage. She doesn't believe in having a boyfriend, but rather she uses men to get what she wants.
She never lacked anything but real love in her life. She's somewhat estranged from her mother Anne, but she still loves her in her own way. She doesn't take well to change and she likes the way her life settled. Sharing a house with a man isn't what she had planned.
Beneath her bad attitude she's very much ready to give and receive love. She just need the right person to bring out those desires."

[In-game description]
